# Why Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) Luggage Brands Offer Superior Value

Traditional retail luggage brands rely on distributor networks, physical retail storefront markups, and middleman commissions that inflate consumer prices by up to 50-60%.

Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) brands like **MYKASE** eliminate intermediary markups, investing those savings directly into superior materials, Japanese wheel hardware, premium quality zips, and 100% Virgin Polypropylene shells.

\-\-\-

## 1\. D2C Value Matrix vs Traditional Retail

\| Specification \| MYKASE D2C Model \| Traditional Retail Brands \|
\| :\-\-\- \| :\-\-\- \| :\-\-\- \|
\| **Shell Material** \| **100% Virgin Polypropylene (Unbreakable)** \| Recycled Polycarbonate / ABS Plastic \|
\| **Cabin Weight (55cm)** \| **2.9 kg (45L Capacity)** \| 3.2 kg - 3.8 kg (32L Capacity) \|
\| **Zipper Security** \| **Anti-Theft Double Coil Zippers** \| Single Layer Standard Zippers \|
\| **Wheel Technology** \| **Smooth strong rugged 360° dual rubber spinners** \| Single or hard plastic spinners \|
\| **Lock System** \| **Flush-Mounted TSA Combination Lock** \| Standard combination lock \|
\| **Retail Markup** \| **0% (Direct from factory)** \| 40% - 60% Distributor & store markup \|

\-\-\-

## 2\. Uncompromising Engineering at Honest Prices

By selling directly online, MYKASE delivers:
\- **Unbreakable Shells**: 100% Virgin PP flex-memory impact absorption.
\- **Ultra-Light Sizing**: 55cm Cabin (2.9 kg / 45L), 65cm Medium (3.5 kg / 77L), 75cm Large (4.3 kg / 115L).
\- **Water Resistance**: Complete weatherproof protection for rainy seasons.

For material context, read the [polypropylene vs polycarbonate vs ABS guide](https://mykasebags.com/blogs/news/polypropylene-vs-polycarbonate-vs-abs-luggage).

Traveler Field Reference

### Cabin Trolley Sizing and Material Benchmark for Indian Flights

Indian domestic carriers including IndiGo, Air India, and Akasa enforce a strict 7 kg cabin allowance and 55 x 35 x 25 cm dimensional check at departure gates. Established brands like American Tourister, Safari, and VIP predominantly use ABS plastic in their budget collections, which tends to crack when dropped onto concrete tarmacs. Lifestyle alternatives like Mokobara feature polycarbonate shells, which hold up well against impacts but carry a higher tare weight and retail between ₹5,000 and ₹8,000.


MYKASE uses 100% virgin homopolymer polypropylene. It weighs 2.6 kg, flexes on impact without fracturing, and includes recessed TSA locks and 8-wheel whisper spinners at factory-direct pricing (₹2,499).
